## Summary
- require Host RSS formal gate reports to bind to scripts/macos_dev_host.py readiness JSON
- fail closed unless readiness proves current-source clean provenance, stable signing, listener observation, identity-bound Screen Recording/Accessibility/Microphone TCC, and read-only safety metadata
- make real-device and Phase 0 aggregate revalidation consume host_readiness source inputs, with tests and docs updated

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_host_rss_gate tools.tests.test_real_device_gate tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile tools/vibescreen_evidence/host_rss_gate.py tools/vibescreen_evidence/real_device_gate.py tools/vibescreen_evidence/phase0_stable_release.py tools/tests/test_host_rss_gate.py tools/tests/test_real_device_gate.py tools/tests/test_phase0_stable_release.py
- make phase0-stable-release-gate (summary remains aggregate=blocked, host_rss=blocked)
- git diff --check

## Not run
- Did not start Vibe Screen/MacHost/Telemachus GUI
- Did not run swift run
- Did not request or modify Screen Recording/Accessibility/Microphone/Keychain/TCC/System Settings
- Did not run adb reverse or real device soak
title: Harden Host RSS readiness gate evidence binding
